lines.en: I call Ayane in an attempt to invite her out for breakfast, but am immediately met with the insistence that {i}she{/i} come over to cook breakfast for me instead.
lines.zh: 我给 Ayane 打电话想约她出去吃早饭，结果立刻被{i}她{/i}坚持要过来给我做早饭顶了回来。

lines.en: The gesture is fine and all, but seeing as there is already someone who lives here and cooks breakfast for me pretty much every single morning, the novelty of home cooked meals is beginning to wear thin.
lines.zh: 这份心意是好的，不过既然已经有个住在这儿、几乎每天早上给我做早饭的人，家常菜的新鲜感已经开始变淡了。

lines.en: Not to mention that I purposely {i}did not{/i} eat the breakfast prepared for me this morning specifically because of that.
lines.zh: 更别提我今早特意{i}没吃{/i}给我准备的那份早饭，就是因为这个。

lines.en: But hey, if it makes Ayane happy, that’s fine.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，如果这能让 Ayane 开心，那也行。

lines.en: I’m sure the sudden understanding of how the world is on an infinite loop must be weighing down on her in some way, so she deserves every win she can get right now-
lines.zh: 我确信「世界是一个无限循环」这个突然的认知，多少压在她身上，所以眼下她值得拿到每一个能拿到的胜利——

lines.en: And I will gladly stomach yet another home cooked meal to support that.
lines.zh: 而我会乐意再忍一顿家常菜来支持这件事。

lines.en: Or at least that’s how I thought I’d feel before she made me something healthy in an effort to “Save my cholesterol levels from exploding.”
lines.zh: 至少在她为了「拯救我即将爆炸的胆固醇」而给我做了点健康食物之前，我是这么想的。

lines.en: It is at this moment that I understand she is only here to torment me and that her insistence of personally cooking for me is just one part of a very detailed plan to adjust my diet.
lines.zh: 就在这一刻我明白了：她来这儿只是为了折磨我，而她坚持亲自下厨，只是一个「调整我饮食」的详细计划的一部分。

lines.en: Of course, she denies this accusation and forces me to eat her food. Which, while certainly {i}good,{/i} is not what I wanted.
lines.zh: 当然，她否认了这项指控，并逼我把她的食物吃下去。那东西确实{i}不错{/i}，但不是我想要的。

lines.en: And I will never forgive her for this.
lines.zh: 而我永远不会原谅她这件事。
